title: Problemas con enlace xdrip
symptom: The user cannot open or install the xDrip application after downloading it from a link.
fix: The thread suggests enabling installation from unknown sources in the phone's security settings, but the user reports still unable to install.
evidence_quote: Debe permitir aplicaciones desconocidas a través de su teléfono. Verifique en la configuración de seguridad.
